description: This file defines the main chat page component for a conversational chatbot platform. It manages the chat state, simulates assistant responses, and integrates other UI components like Header, ChatContainer, and ChatInput. It also includes style theming and placeholder comments for backend API integration.

methods.name: ChatPage
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders the chat interface, manages state, and handles message flow including simulated responses.

methods.name: simulateAssistantResponse
methods.description: Asynchronously simulates an assistant reply after a delay, with placeholders for real backend API calls.

methods.name: handleSend
methods.description: Handles sending user messages, updating state, and triggering the assistant response.
